description: Block an agent so nobody in the organisation can use it, or lift an existing block. This is a governance action across the whole tenant, not a deployment one: it does not unpublish or delete the agent, and it affects every user at once. Changes a live tenant: requires confirm: true. Needs the CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All permission and runs against Graph beta, the only version that exposes it (cs_login scope 'graph_write'). Needs a Microsoft Agent 365 licence and is global-cloud only. Unverified against a live tenant.

blocked.description: true blocks the agent for everyone, false lifts the block

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

id.description: Package id from cs_list_org_agents, e.g. P_19ae1zz1-56bc-505a-3d42-156df75a4xxy

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_block_org_agent
title: Block or unblock an agent for the organisation
